name: proctoriq-monorepo
description: ProctorIQ — DBMS-Centric Online Exam Monitoring & Anti-Cheating System

scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.lint: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -p none "npm --prefix server run lint" "npm --prefix client run lint"
scripts.typecheck: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -p none "npm --prefix server run typecheck" "npm --prefix client run typecheck"
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test:server && npm run test:e2e
